outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 423 patients with a history of prior cesarean section, singleton pregnancy with cephalic presentation, and gestational age of 37-41 weeks
finding: There was no statistically significant difference between VBAC and ERCD in terms of maternal or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) had similar maternal and perinatal outcomes compared to elective repeat cesarean delivery (ERCD).
